title: Launch kit
slide_intent: Show how to select a small set of assets for a public release. Someone preparing a launch needs to know which piece carries the invitation, announcement, street message or referral.
strategic_value: Halfkey can keep the launch recognizable across successive encounters while giving each piece a distinct job. The closing line and mark bring the set back to its central promise.
demonstration: Four captioned assets progress from a waitlist teaser to a launch post, an eight-sheet poster and a referral card. A full-width dark panel closes the book with the brand promise, founder contact and split mark.
practical_value: A designer can choose the deliverable for a release stage by reading its caption and comparing the channel, format and message with the adjacent examples.

content_islands.name: Running header and kit label
content_islands.spec: Place Halfkey and Brand book at upper left, Launch kit and 20 at upper right, then repeat Launch kit above the asset row.

content_islands.name: Launch assets
content_islands.spec: Arrange four pieces in release order. Use narrow portraits for “Write your first key.” and “Out now on iPhone.”, a wide blue street poster for the $40 limit, and a white referral card with “Give a friend half a key.” Place a format and release caption beneath each.

content_islands.name: Closing signature
content_islands.spec: Run an ink field across the full lower panel. Set “Give it half the key.” large at left, place the founder and contact details below it, and anchor the white-and-blue split disc at right.
